notes: PRA-CSLD is a Bosch PRAESENSA desktop LCD call station (paging/intercom microphone station for PA/voice-alarm systems), not a conventional AV source/display device — category/type were mapped to the closest fit ("control"/"Control processor"); it could also reasonably be tagged "Touch panel" given its 4.3" touchscreen UI. It has no discrete power connector: power arrives exclusively via PoE on the two RJ45 OMNEO network ports (IEEE 802.3af mode B, 48V, 37-57VDC tolerance, 4.2W general/5.4W alarm use). Built-in gooseneck microphone and internal monitor loudspeaker are fixed/integrated components, not externally connectorized ports, so they are not listed separately. Desktop unit (130 x 62 x 189 mm, 0.9 kg) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Source datasheet is Bosch-branded (© Bosch Security Systems 2020, doc 24814072843, V3, 10 Jul 2020) hosted on the current successor domain keenfinity-group.com; Bosch's building/security-systems business (including PRAESENSA) was transferred to KEENFINITY Group in 2025, but the product remains marketed under the Bosch brand on this datasheet. Company page for the product (boschsecurity.com/keenfinity-group.com product listing) redirected/404'd, so the PDF datasheet itself was used directly as the authoritative source.

ports.name: OMNEO 1 (PoE PD)
ports.note: Network+control+audio port (100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T, OMNEO/AES128). Also accepts Power over Ethernet, IEEE 802.3af mode B, 48V nominal — this is the device's power input; there is no separate power jack.

ports.name: OMNEO 2 (PoE PD)
ports.note: Redundant loop-through OMNEO network port, identical to OMNEO 1; also accepts PoE (802.3af mode B).

ports.name: Local source audio line input
ports.note: 3.5 mm jack line-level input for background music; stereo-to-mono converted internally.

ports.name: PRA-CSE interconnection
ports.note: Datasheet specifies an RJ12 (6P6C) modular jack, which is not in the allowed connector list; RJ45 (closest modular-jack id) is used as an approximation. Carries control data + LED status to/from up to four PRA-CSE call-station extensions.
